An intelligent and domineering woman encounters a carefree, flamboyant prince at a brothel. Initially, she thinks of it as nothing more than a chance meeting, but little did she know their fates would end up being so deeply intertwined…  
  
"If you hold no love for me, then I will give up my love for you as well."  
  
A romance story about love and loss set in ancient times.

In an accident, university student Song Xiao An is kidnapped and brought deep into the mountains, ripping her away from her peaceful and happy life. There, an undercover police officer named Zhou Si Han secretly takes care of her, and Xiao An thinks she can escape through her. However, she discovers that the policewoman is hiding a dark secret...

Tang Qian dropped out of college to work in order to find a cure for his father’s illness. One day when he was standing up for the owner of an antique shop, he bumped into a cinnabar furnace. From that day onward, he had gained a special ability whereby an elder sage’s voice could be heard speaking to him in his mind, telling him a patient’s diagnosis and course of treatment upon seeing the patient. He verified that the sage’s prescriptions were truly effective and could even save patients on the verge of death. His actions of saving people were caught on by the hospital and people were sent to investigate him. Nevertheless, Tang Qian wanted to treat his father’s illness with his newfound ability. However, the ingredients for his father’s prescription could not be found in this world. Alas, he could only continue working for his father’s medical bills. He bought that very cinnabar furnace that he bumped into because it could have something to do with his special powers. He also believed that he had not fully manifested his powers yet. One night, he gained another clairvoyant ability...

Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Luego, fue golpeado por un segundo ataque crítico: durante el día se enfrentaba contra el matón, pero todas las noches, ¡tenía intimidad con el matón en sus sueños! Todo parece estar fuera de control ¿Cómo debería el príncipe heredero, quien nunca se había equivocado, enfrentarse a su inesperado primer amor?

description.en:
Studious and strong-willed An Kele has always tried to live her life unswayed by others, preferring to judge people with her own eyes. Due to her mother working overseas, she moves in with her aunt and soon encounters a handsome host named Yan Shu. Though fascinated by him, she is determined to work hard in school and be noticed by her upperclassman, Bai Yiran.

Unbeknownst to An Kele, the name "Yan Shu" is just an alias of her classmate Ye Ling, who moonlights as a host to alleviate the crippling debt left behind by his absconded father. While Yan Shu charms with his confident smile and silver tongue, Ye Ling is a brooding school truant—the type of person that the diligent An Kele can't help but dislike.

Though their relationship starts off both bitter and sweet, An Kele and Ye Ling find themselves tied together by fate—and so, the duo face each trial and tribulation that comes their way, chasing the bright future that comes with the rising sun.
